cases.why: the closed sheet loses `inert` in the markup, so until someone opens and closes it once, its five buttons are back in the Tab order -- on a desktop, where it never opens, that is forever. Focus disappears off the bottom of the screen for five presses and nothing on the page shows it.
closing the sheet no longer makes it inert again, so the first open-and-close on a phone puts the hidden buttons back in the Tab order and the screen reader's list for the rest of the visit.
the More button toggles the class directly again, as it did before, so the sheet slides open while still inert -- visible, and not one of its buttons can be reached or pressed.
